rule.obligation: Retain member identity value, comparison and lookup behavior

state.obligation: Retain owner, storage, initializer, reset and visible update

binding.obligation: Retain bidirectional writeback and parent ownership

event.obligation: Follow input through processing to observable feedback

branch.obligation: Exercise both branch outcomes and boundary values

task.obligation: Retain restart, cancellation, isolation and stale-result handling

navigation.obligation: Retain destination, parameters, return and modal state

persistence.obligation: Follow save to reload to business effect, including failures

service.obligation: Retain request, response, permission, errors and lifecycle contract

lifecycle.obligation: Retain creation, appearance, disappearance and cleanup

constraint.obligation: Retain relation, priority and layout under actual bounds

identity.obligation: Retain stable identity and state-reset boundaries

resource.obligation: Map variants, localization and logical dimensions without silent fallback

composition.obligation: Retain view composition, conditional content and container behavior

modifier.obligation: Retain modifier ordering and its measured effect

environment.obligation: Retain injected scope, defaults and updates

language.obligation: Retain nil/default/error distinctions and optional values

ownership.obligation: Retain reference ownership, weak captures and cleanup

delegate.obligation: Resolve callback receiver, ordering, optional methods and observable effect
